title: Playboy Magazine October 1990 Girls of the Big West Buster Douglas
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:

Features:
